additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441526-DC/SI-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003980] Charger out of service CRM:02678000158
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael Frenger,
I wanted to inform you that charger outlet was temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error.
The COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the Si-D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue, charger outlets were temporarily unavailable. The issue has been resolved, Outlets are available now.
We will continue to monitor the situation for next 24 hours. If the issue reoccur during this period, we will
escalate this case to experts.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0441526-DC/SI-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003980] Charger out of service CRM:02678000158
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael Frenger,
Following our analysis of the system logs, we have confirmed that the error occurred only three times, resulting in a total downtime of approximately 15 seconds for the outlet.
This level of occurrence is within expected and acceptable operating limits, and no further action is required at this time.
However, if we observe an increase in the frequency of this error, we will move forward with deploying a hotfix to address the issue.
Kindly give us permission for case closure.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
